card.name: Start of text right after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word or sentence-ending period just after a section heading in a drug label, such as Dosage, Dilution, Vaccinations or Drug Interactions. The heading is run straight into the body text.

modes.label: Body text after heading
modes.description: First piece of the opening word right after a heading, often a split word like Dos, Dil or Vacc.

modes.label: Period in interactions opener
modes.description: The period ending the first sentence under a Drug Interactions heading.
